requirements: High-Caliber and Seraph require an outgoing flinch modifier; combatant stagger is distinct from actual aim rotation.
No Distractions requires an ADS timing rule and incoming flinch multiplier.
Zen Moment distinguishes visual weapon shake and reticle bounce from actual recoil or camera motion; uncertain coefficients remain unknown.
implemented_contract: apply_aim_impulse adds explicit signed degree values to real yaw/pitch; values may use existing numeric profiles.

Minecraft 26.3 Entity.forceSetRotation and PositionMoveRotation.calculateAbsolute apply native float addition and pitch limits. ServerPlayer sends ClientboundPlayerRotationPacket with both relative flags.
The native client adds the requested angles to current local aim, clamps pitch, resets old rotation and immediately reports ServerboundMovePlayerPacket.Rot.
Receipt measures synchronous host rotation, not a client acknowledgement. An in-flight client aim difference may change local clamping; mouse movement remains native.
No automatic aim recovery, recoil curve, visual-only reticle shake, damage-to-flinch mapping or combatant stagger is inferred from this primitive.
